blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Friday directed the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) to submit a comprehensive report regarding the authorization of former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez’s personal helper within 48 hours. His directive follows BJMP’s admission before the Sandiganbayan Third Division that it allowed Romualdez’s staff to attend to his needs inside his cell. The lawmaker is detained at a Quezon City Jail over a plunder case in connection with the alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion.
